# SetTextAreaTabs <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Text Areas](BlitzPlus-Text-Areas)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetTextAreaTabs:Void textarea:Int32, tabs:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `textarea` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of a text area. |
| `tabs` | In | Int32 | required | Width of a tab. |

## Description

Sets how wide a tab character is, independent of the font.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win  = CreateWindow("Tabs", 10, 10, 300, 150, Desktop(), 3)
area = CreateTextArea(10, 10, 270, 90, win)
SetTextAreaTabs area, 40
SetGadgetText area, "a" + Chr$(9) + "b" + Chr$(9) + "c"
Repeat
Until WaitEvent() = $803
```
